section: 5/8/2018Enacted by Chapter 442, 2018 General Session2018Military Installation Development Authority exemption.Amounts paid or charged for accommodations and services, as defined in Section 63H-1-205, are exempt from the tax described in Section 59-28-103, if the amounts are paid to or charged by a proprietor subject to the MIDA accommodations tax imposed under Section 63H-1-205.
